best_echo_sets.commentary: Best set for Aero Erosion supports. Allows characters that can apply Aero Erosion to gain a total of 40% Aero DMG Bonus, an equivalent to Sierra Gale. However, it gains an edge over this set by being able to give 15% of that Aero DMG Bonus to the whole team for 20s, providing both offensive and supportive benefits. This set is only favoured on Ciaccona if an Aero Main DPS is present in the team. Use Moonlit Clouds if this doesn't apply.

main_echo_options.echo_commentary: This Echo provides a free decent amount of Aero DMG when casting Outro Skill in all situations, provides 12% Aero DMG Bonus to Ciaccona and while its Transform Active Skill is not used in Ciaccona's rotations, it is the best Main Echo she has, albeit by a very small difference when compared to Reminiscence: Fleurdelys (pick what has the best substats, or use Fleurdelys if Ciaccona uses Lux & Umbra as her weapon as explained above!)

best_echo_sets.commentary: Best set for Ciaccona in all non-Aero teams. This set sacrifices Ciaccona's personal damage in order to provide higher buffing to a single character. It provides an extra 10% Energy Regen to the wielder unconditionally and gives 22.5% ATK to the incoming character for 15s after casting Outro skill, making it one of the strongest sets to buff any ATK-scaling DPS.

main_echo_options.echo_commentary: The best and only real option 5P Moonlit Clouds has, as it grants an extra 12% DMG Bonus on top of the ATK boost to the next character that Moonlit Clouds would usually give. Additionally restores a lot of Energy to the caster when it deals damage. On Ciaccona, this Echo should either be used before her rotation starts or it can be instantly interrupted at any point via a Dash - this way, no Energy or damage is generated but the buff will still apply to the incoming character.

best_echo_sets.commentary: Used with Main DPS Ciaccona. Best set for Aero Main DPS characters who can apply Aero Erosion or have an Aero Erosion applier on the team. Grants 10% Aero DMG Bonus and an extra 30% Aero DMG Bonus as well as 10% CRIT Rate for 10s when attacking targets inflicted with Aero Erosion. Offers an extra 10% CRIT Rate over the other Aero sets such as Gusts of Welkin or Sierra Gale, providing extra overall damage so long as Aero Erosion is present on the enemy.

main_echo_options.echo_commentary: This Echo provides a free decent amount of Aero DMG when casting Outro Skill in all situations, provides 12% Aero DMG Bonus to Ciaccona and while its Transform Active Skill is not used in Ciaccona's rotations, it is the best Main Echo she has, albeit by a very small difference when compared to Reminiscence: Fleurdelys (pick what has the best substats!)

best_weapons.commentary_details: The best option overall for Ciaccona not only from a personal damage perspective but also from a team damage perspective as this weapon shreds the Aero RES of enemies by 10%, which is particularly useful in Aero teams. Still outclasses all other options in any teams thanks to its big personal damage boost.

best_weapons.commentary_details: An amazing generalist permanently available pistol that can universally improve the wearer's ATK, DMG Bonus and CRIT DMG. Can get close to a lot of character signatures and is overall a must-have for most accounts. Better than Static Mist in compositions that don't benefit from its ATK buff such as Cartethyia's team.

weapon_base_info.effect_description: Increases ATK by {0}. When a Resonator in the team casts a Tune Break skill, it grants {1} All-Attribute DMG Bonus to the wielder for 14s.

best_weapons.commentary_details: Best Echo with this weapon is Reminiscence: Fleurdelys. Galbrena's Signature has a good Base ATK and CRIT DMG boosts, but can also amplify Heavy Attack DMG and Echo Skill DMG when both damage types are triggered close to one another alongside an extra DEF Ignore buff. Ciaccona takes a solid damage increase from the Heavy Attack DMG Amplify and DEF Ignore towards the end of her rotation if she uses her Echo Skill while her Forte Heavy Attack is about to cast, making it a great alternative overall.

weapon_base_info.effect_description: ATK is increased by {0}. Upon dealing Echo Skill DMG, gain {1} Heavy Attack DMG Amplification for 6s. Upon dealing Heavy Attack DMG, gain {1} Echo Skill DMG Amplification for 6s. DMG Amplification on each attack is capped at {1}. While both effects are active, dealing damage ignores {2} of the target's DEF.

best_weapons.commentary_details: Lynae's Signature weapon can proivde extra Basic Attack DMG to Ciaccona and also has a lot of CRIT Rate and ATK for her to benefit from, however she cannot trigger the party-wide buff this weapon provides which makes it generally worse than the permanent banner weapons.

Each time the wielder inflicts Tune Rupture - Shifting or Tune Strain - Shifting during Basic Attacks, all DMG dealt by Resonators in the team is increased by {2} for 30s, up to 3 stacks. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked.

best_weapons.commentary_details: While Ciaccona takes full advantage of this weapon's passive thanks to her really short rotation, Skill DMG is the most negligible part of her damage types which makes this weapon mostly an atk and CRIT DMG stat-stick. Still a good choice for personal damage overall.

weapon_base_info.effect_description: Increases ATK by {0}. Every time Intro Skill or Resonance Liberation is cast, Resonance Skill DMG Bonus increases by {1} for 5s.

best_weapons.commentary_details: Can outclass Phasic Homogenizer in ATK-scaling teams thanks to team buffing. One of the 2 best permanently available options for Ciaccona, which makes her give 10% ATK to the next character she Outros into and also provides her with high Base ATK, CRIT Rate and some Energy Regen, making her take full advantage of the weapon's passive.

best_weapons.commentary_details: Best 4-star and F2P no-gacha option for Ciaccona, this Rinascita craftable synergizes well with her ability to apply Aero Erosion constantly on enemies, allowing her to take full advantage of this weapon's massive ATK increase. Still lower than other options because it only provides ATK (and 4-stars have lower Base ATK than 5-stars too which makes increasing ATK% less effective).

weapon_base_info.effect_description: Dealing DMG to enemies with Negative Statuses increases the wielder's ATK by {0} for 10s. This effect can be triggered 1 time per second, stackable up to 4 times.

example_teams.team_notes: Chisa is only stronger than Aero Rover with her Signature. Shorekeeper is also mostly usable in the third slot in Whimpering Wastes since Aero Erosion won't have time to ramp up to 6.
Iuno + Lynae + Ciaccona is also one of DPS Iuno's strongest teams by far, exceeding the teams shown here if you have access to it.
Shorekeeper will only really see use on DPS Phoebe teams in Whimpering Wastes, however it is DPS Phoebe's best Whimpering Wastes team and is worth mentioning.

cons: May need you to build 2 separate Echo Sets for her to access her team flexibility (Gusts of Welkin is only used in Aero teams, Moonlit Clouds for general use);
A lot of her potential is locked behind her Signature weapon in Aero teams or as a Main DPS;
Sings during her Ultimate which replaces a potentially epic battle theme by a silly song.

sections.heading: Summary
paragraphs: Ciaccona is a 5-star Aero Pistol DPS whose primary point of interest is her ability to apply both Spectro Frazzle and Aero Erosion (mostly via her Ultimate). She amplifies Aero Erosion DMG and boosts Aero DMG in several ways, and is characterized by her ability to rotate quickly while retaining an off-field presence, similar to Coordinated Attackers (even though she isn't one). She additionally has great personal damage if you wish to play her as a Main DPS, it is a completely viable playstyle for her.
We'll go through her abilities in order of how we execute them in her rotation. Her kit is honestly pretty simplistic so this won't take long.

Her Intro skill allows her to skip instantly to Basic Attack stage 3 — this is important because stage 4 is the only important part of her Basic chain. Beyond that, it applies 1 stack of Aero Erosion, and like other Intros it generates a good chunk of Concerto Energy and does minor damage quickly.

Her Basic Attack stage 1 and 2 are pretty much never used, so only stage 3 and 4 matter. Stage 4 can be interrupted by several means, the primary method we use for this is with a jump. Why it's important to do so is because it generates a wind clone of Ciaccona called an "Ensemble Sylph". These Ensemble Sylphs have the effect of activating a "Solo Concert" which gives all party members 24% Aero DMG Bonus as long as the Ensemble Sylph is present. On top of this, the Ensemble Sylph will fully complete Ciaccona's Basic Attack 4 even if it is cancelled, so you can cancel it at no loss. The duration of Ensemble Sylphs is permanent, but only 2 can exist at any given time. Due to this, you can pretty much consider this buff's uptime as permanent. Note however that Solo Concert will not be activated on the specific condition that Ciaccona's Basic Attack 4 is cancelled with her Skill.

An interesting perk of cancelling Ciaccona's Basic 4 with a Jump is that it puts her in the air and allows her to follow up with her Mid-Air Attacks. Mid-Air Attack 2 naturally follows up into Basic Attack 4, which means you can chain Basic Attack 4's quickly together by repeatedly Jump cancelling. We make extensive use of this in her Main DPS rotation and her Opener rotation to shorten it a great amount, we use it once in her standard SubDPS rotation as well to speed things up.
The reason why we do Basic Attack 4 is for 3 things:
Charging up 1 of 3 Forte Circuit stacks called "Musical Essence" (we explain this later);
Applying 1 stack of Aero Erosion while generating Concerto Energy.
Ciaccona's Resonance Skill is similar to her Basic 4 in terms of applying 1 stack of Aero Erosion, other than that it's a quick boost to her Concerto Energy which we make good use of.

After building up 3 Forte stacks total, including 1 from her Intro and 2 from her Basic 4 done 2 times, we can cast a special Forte Heavy Attack called "Quadruple Downbeat". It generates a massive 25 Concerto Energy, a necessary boost to finish Ciaccona's rotation. On top of this, it deals a great amount of damage and applies 1 more Aero Erosion stack. It also has the additional effect of gathering enemies in its center by pulling them in, which is great for dealing with small targets all at once.

Last but not least, Ciaccona's Ultimate causes her to enter a singing state called "Recital" on top of doing a big wave of AoE damage. This state will last even if she is switched off-field, and every 1.6s she is able to either manually input or automatically perform a wave of damage called "Symphonic Poem: Tonic". Depending on the mode chosen at the start of her Ultimate (Aero Erosion mode by default), she will inflict either Aero Erosion or Spectro Frazzle on all enemies hit. It is possible to almost instantly switch from Aero Erosion to Spectro Frazzle after casting her Ultimate so the process isn't too slow. Once this is performed, she is ready to switch out and apply waves of Status Inflictions off-field. Her Outro even amplifies all Aero Erosion DMG by 100%, so her Aero Erosion actually ends up dealing solid off-field damage, especially with Aero Rover in the mix to stack Aero Erosion up to 6 times instead of 3.

Regarding her meta position, Ciaccona was already in a good niche without Cartethyia and now that she's finally released she's even stronger. Similarly to the synergy Zani and Phoebe have, Ciaccona and Cartethyia complement each other's kits perfectly. Ciaccona's low field time as a SubDPS paired with Cartethyia's high field time perfectly complement each other, and her multi-wave AoE Erosion application allows Cartethyia to utilize her kit to the fullest. Cartethyia being one of the strongest damage dealers in Wuthering Waves, maybe even the strongest, makes Ciaccona a very high-demand unit from this factor alone.

However, even without considering Cartethyia as a teammate, she's already a character who can slot in many teams. The main points of interest are as a Main DPS, and with Absolution Phoebe a.k.a Main DPS Phoebe. She's really strong with her because she's able to apply Spectro Frazzle across several waves of enemies, a feature Phoebe was dearly missing to perform in Whimpering Wastes. Ciaccona allows her not only to perform in the gamemode, but to perform to top tier level alongside each other.

Additionally, Ciaccona deals amazing personal damage if her rotation is extended thanks to her ability to chain Basic 4's really quickly together, which allows her to access her Forte Heavy Attack multiple times in a single rotation. Able to access it twice, or even thrice depending on the team, Ciaccona is an excellent Main DPS choice particularly in Whimpering Wastes when paired with Sanhua to buff her Basic Attack damage and allow her to take a lot of field time. This is thanks to her ability to group enemies and spread her damage all throughout her rotation, even dealing some damage off-field via her Ultimate.

In a team with Jiyan, he and Ciaccona are a good pair even though Mortefi can be considered stronger in single-target scenarios. With that being said, Ciaccona has more AoE damage which is something to be considered, but she does boost Jiyan's damage much less than Mortefi. Overall it's difficult to pick one, we consider them pretty equal in performance to each other but this does add to Ciaccona's team flexibility.

Furthermore, Ciaccona can be used as a second Frazzle applier for Zani alongside Spectro Rover which allows Zani to access more extended combos without Phoebe, which Spectro Rover alone couldn't cover before. Phoebe however remains the best Frazzle support for Zani.

In conclusion, Ciaccona is a character who has quick rotations, AoE capabilities, slots in many teams, while buffing damage by good amounts and dealing very good damage of her own. Overall, she is desirable for many characters and can even be used as a Main DPS herself, allowing her a ton of flexibility, one of the highest in the game. Besides, her full potential lies with one of the best damage dealers in the game currently, if not the best. All this to say, Ciaccona is one of the most valuable characters, as you are sure to have a viable team for her on your account no matter what, some of her strongest synergies making up for some of the strongest teams in the game, cementing her position as a top meta character.

synergies.commentary: Ciaccona is at her best in Aero Erosion or Aero damage-focused teams, whether in the second or the third slot. This is because she provides universal Aero DMG buffs, and a coveted Aero RES Shred with her Signature weapon alongside solid personal damage and a quick rotation which makes her good in all Aero-based teams; she also has off-field Aero Erosion application which makes her the best partner for Cartethyia by far. Overall she is a very flexible character for all Aero teams in the game.

Ciaccona is also appreciated in Spectro Frazzle-based teams since she can switch from applying Aero Erosion off-field to Spectro Frazzle. This makes her the only possible partner for Absolution Phoebe to function in Whimpering Wastes, and she is also a fine alrernative to Zani teams if Phoebe isn't available, since she can allow for Zani to extend her rotation to cast 3 powerful Nightfall attacks instead of 2 without Phoebe involved. However, outside of Absolution Phoebe in Whimpering Wastes, there's always a choice that outclasses her in Spectro Frazzle teams.

If you want to play Ciaccona as a Main DPS, Sanhua is your best option, enabling this playstyle by providing a massive 38% Basic ATK DMG Amplification, good ATK% and DMG% buffs via S6 and Echo sets as well as having a lightning fast rotation to allow Ciaccona to have the highest field time possible. Easily the best option to use Ciaccona as an on-field DPS.

Ciaccona's long list of Support choices is a byproduct of her huge team flexibility. Chisa and Aero Rover both see use in teams with Cartethyia to enable Aero Erosion to ramp up to 6; Aero Rover is also used alongside Main DPS Iuno for general Aero buffs; Spectro Rover is used with Zani and Phoebe for higher Spectro Frazzle application; lastly, Shorekeeper and Verina are your best generalist bets. Pick and choose based on your team and what's available, Ciaccona works well with all of them!
